title: WHO reports progress against neglected tropical diseases
summary: WHO reports that 63 countries had eliminated at least one NTD by June 2026. The number of people requiring NTD interventions fell to 1.41 billion in 2024, a 36% reduction since 2010. Guinea worm disease recorded only 10 human cases in 2025, while dengue cases reached 15.1 million in 2024.
